title: ampelaster carolinianus
intro: Ampelaster carolinianus, commonly known as Carolina Rose of Sharon, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Ampelaster carolinianus include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant properties that may help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ampelaster carolinianus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Ampelaster carolinianus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
